name: The Lean library is clean, coherent and tooled
asks:
I am tired of arguing between your inferences derived from content on disc and what I am telling you things have to be.

Something has gone HORRIBLY wrong where this Lean has turned into like, just vibes.

There was a time, I promise, when this was like, a clean and coherent Lean library, deriving common formula from a new basis, relationality, which starts with articulating. The scale of the Lean - that it covers so much mathematics - isn't the issue: that's desired.

It's that it lsot its coherence as a matheamtical program, from the original research and theories, mostly because engineering agents weren't forbidden from editing the Lean to write Lean to prove whatever they wanted to give themselves false certificates.

The ideas in the Lean are good, it's just that the proofs themselves take shortcuts and don't build up the way we really need them to.

You, as Fable, can do more to undrstand the high level concepts, to pla better tooling, docs, whatever, for helping us work with this Lean formalization better over time. Agreed on better tooling: muuuch better tooling, all around. It's clear the math is trying some ambitious shit, and what's wild is how much of it works, and you can trace that logic, like I said, from fregean predication to FOUR to chu space and beyond. What we're doing is in many ways reminiscent of lots of frontier math, but the construction of it all within one system like this is the strange part. Study our blueprints, verso, and any other notes you can find anyplace to better understand the like, quasicrystal 4d math territory we're exploring, settling. (territory and settling here are chosen intentionall: Obsmetrologia is mean tto construct that territory, its conurbation, tiling, etc.
